Thank you for using Metronome Beats!  You can contact us at support@stonekick.com with any questions.

Check out the preferences menu to see what options are available.

Like many apps, this app uses cookies and other identifiers which are shared with our advertising and analytics partners.  See our privacy policy for details.  By continuing to use this app you indicate that you consent to this.

Does your instrument need tuning? We have released a new tuner app. You can access it from the main menu or click on the button below.
